summary: Driven by demand from Lionel Messi's arrival, Inter Miami has sharply raised 2024 season ticket prices, making them among the most expensive in world football and far above other MLS clubs. The cheapest ticket rises 78.8% and the midfield club seat 113%, while premium packages top $45,000. A computer glitch also sent some season ticket holders inflated renewal quotes, though the real increases were still steep.
one_line: Inter Miami's 2024 season tickets, inflated by Messi demand, jump up to 113% and rank among the world's most expensive, dwarfing other MLS clubs.
key_facts: Inter Miami's cheapest season ticket was $485 in 2023 and rises to $884 for 2024 in the original listing, an increase of 78.8%.
A lower-level midfield club season ticket cost $3,600 in 2023 and will cost $7,650 in 2024, an increase of 113%.
The most expensive 2024 Inter Miami packages are Mid Loge at $45,900, and North Loge and South Loge at $42,840 each.
The cheapest 2024 season ticket is $867 (South Stand), which works out to $51 per match across 17 home games.
A West Reserved seat, in the upper deck near midfield, costs $140 per match in 2024.
The cheapest Barcelona season ticket is $377, and Barcelona's most expensive is $1,826 for the full year.
Tottenham's cheapest ticket is around $974 and its most expensive package is $2,498; Fulham's Craven Cottage luxury booths at $3,620 are the most expensive in the EPL.
Orlando City SC's cheapest 2024 season ticket is $324 and its most expensive is $2,898; Atlanta United's cheapest is $605, or $525 for founding members.
The NFL's average ticket price was $112 in 2022 and the NBA's was $94.
Fox Sports reported that Inter Miami has an extensive waiting list for 2024 season tickets, and the price hike could push out supporters who have been with the team since 2020.
Mike Ryan, a guest on The Dan LeBatard Show, received a glitched renewal quote of $30,600 for two seats that cost $6,802 in 2023.
Ryan's corrected price is about $15,300 for two seats, an increase of 125% year-on-year.
Fans who renew by October 7 receive a discount.
